title: The in-memory outcome records kept the written object itself, so a later change to it altered the stored record, unlike PostgreSQL
resolution: The adapter stores a frozen copy; a shared conformance case that changes the input after the write failed on the in-memory adapter before the fix and passes after it.

title: No test covered a placement that commits while the waiting record's transaction is open after its waiting read, the case the serializable guard exists for
resolution: Added a PostgreSQL test, with and without an earlier record, that places the task on another connection while the waiting record's transaction pauses after its read, and expects a serialization retry and no record left. It needs Docker.

title: The removal of the outcome on placement was tested only when it succeeds; a failed removal was not shown to roll the placement back
resolution: Added a unit test and a PostgreSQL test that fail the removal: the pass fails, the earlier record stays, and in PostgreSQL no assignment, offer, or cursor move commits. The unit test failed with the removal error ignored.

title: The contract still said a pass whose first offer meets a full fleet writes nothing, although it now writes a waiting record
resolution: The statement now covers only the cursor and points to the recorded outcome bullet.

title: The record said the PostgreSQL tests first ran at the passing make verify, although the failed run on the merge had already run them
resolution: The record names both runs: the tests passed in the failed run on the merge and again in the passing run.

title: A pass that ends at a fleet decline leaves the tasks it did not offer with an older record or none, which neither the contract nor the design said
resolution: Contract section 13 and the design's risks now say so, with the quota example, and that the projection reconciles the record's time with its own fleet read.

title: The remaining gates still listed review pass 1 after it was recorded
resolution: The remaining gates list only the later review passes.

title: The scenario promised no record for a task cancelled during the waiting write, although a cancellation that overlaps it after its read does not conflict and the record stays
resolution: The scenario now covers a wait that ends before the read, a new scenario covers a placement during the write, and the contract and design say an overlapping cancellation may leave a record that readers gate on the task state.

title: The contract and spec delta read as if an empty fleet recorded no-candidate, against the coordinator decision that it records nothing
resolution: no-candidate is now recorded only when the placement transaction finds no candidate left after the pass found one; the delta adds the scenarios No candidate in the try and Empty fleet.

title: No test covered the waiting no-candidate record written when the candidates vanish before the placement transaction
resolution: Added a unit test that drains the only worker before the placement transaction and expects a waiting no-candidate record; it failed with the no-candidate fallback removed.

title: The record's value interface shared its name with an export of the execution module, and its unused disposition list duplicated the reason outcome term
resolution: The interface is renamed and no longer exported, the unused list is removed, and the disposition type is derived from ReasonOutcome without standing and used in the record union.

title: The inventory integration tests ran placement passes without truncating the outcome records between tests
resolution: placement_outcomes is in the truncated tables, so no record leaks from one test into the next.

title: The unit test name claimed the task stays unplaced, which the in-memory fixture cannot show because it does not roll back assignments
resolution: Renamed to say the pass fails and the record stays; the record now says the PostgreSQL test is the one that shows nothing commits.

title: The failed waiting write test also failed removals, so an ignored waiting write failure could still surface from another task's removal
resolution: Record and removal failures have separate flags; the test fails only records, and it failed with the waiting write failure ignored.

title: No test showed that the outcome table rejects a disposition or source outside its values
resolution: Added a migration test that expects both check constraints to reject a standing disposition and a worker source, and accepts a valid row; it needs Docker.
